mattress-finder.shortDescription: Find mattresses by sleep position, cooling, firmness, partner needs, trial, and budget.
mattress-finder.longDescription: Mattress Finder helps shoppers compare mattresses using sleep position, firmness preference, cooling needs, motion isolation, mattress size, trial length, warranty, and budget. It provides fit-based rankings, clear tradeoffs, affiliate disclosures, and avoids medical treatment claims.
starterPrompts: Find a queen mattress for a hot side sleeper under $1,500.
Compare mattresses for couples with motion isolation.
Find a firm king mattress with a long trial.
mattress-finder.affiliateDisclosure: Mattress Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
mattress-finder.safetyPolicy: Do not diagnose or claim to treat pain or sleep disorders. Mattress comfort is subjective; users with medical concerns should consult a clinician.
